explication: FoundationPose estimates and tracks 6D poses of novel objects, with model-based CAD and model-free few-shot workflows. In the principal workflow, a user supplies RGB-D frames, camera data, and an object model; dataset readers provide frames, the estimator generates pose hypotheses, and rendering plus learned refinement and scoring support pose selection and subsequent tracking. A separate model-free branch learns a neural object field from reference views and produces a reconstructed mesh for downstream use. The graph follows documented entry points and sampled modules; some connections to unsampled runtime code are supported by the README rather than inspected implementation.
